Bug_Explanation: The bug is using HashMap which is not thread-safe for concurrent access. When multiple threads try to modify the map at the same time, it may lead to unpredictable results or ConcurrentModificationException.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method in ConcurrentHashMapBugTest class calls the showBug method of ConcurrentHashMapBug class, which simulates multi-threaded access without proper synchronization. This triggers the bug where a ConcurrentModificationException might be thrown if access occurs while modification is happening concurrently.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results did not demonstrate the bug being triggered. The test ran successfully without throwing any exceptions, which would have been the case if the ConcurrentModificationException was thrown due to the bug. Therefore, the test results do not confirm the presence of the described bug in the Java code.
